title: Finite-stage model of a morphism
statement:
Let $I$ be a nonempty directed set, let $(S_\lambda)_{\lambda\in I}$ be an inverse system of schemes with affine transition morphisms, and let $S=\varprojlim_{\lambda\in I}S_\lambda$. Fix $\lambda_0\in I$ such that $S_{\lambda_0}$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let $X_{\lambda_0}$ and $Y_{\lambda_0}$ be schemes of finite presentation over $S_{\lambda_0}$. Use [def-nagata-basechanged-system] to write $X_\lambda=X_{\lambda_0}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S_\lambda$, $Y_\lambda=Y_{\lambda_0}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S_\lambda$, and $X=X_{\lambda_0}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S$, $Y=Y_{\lambda_0}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S$. Let $\varphi:X\to Y$ be an $S$-morphism.

Choose a finite affine cover $\{T_j=\operatorname{Spec}R_j\}_j$ of $S_{\lambda_0}$ and a finite affine cover $\{V_{jk}=\operatorname{Spec}B_{jk}\}_{j,k}$ of $Y_{\lambda_0}$ such that $V_{jk}$ maps into $T_j$. Assume each $B_{jk}$ is a finitely presented $R_j$-algebra; fix a finite set $G_{jk}$ of $R_j$-algebra generators and a finite list of defining relations for it. Put $W_{jk}^\infty=\varphi^{-1}(V_{jk}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S)\subseteq X$. Each $W_{jk}^\infty$ is quasi-compact. Use [def-nagata-qc-open-descent] to choose a stage $\lambda_{jk}\geq\lambda_0$ and a descended open $\widetilde W_{jk,\lambda_{jk}}\subseteq X_{\lambda_{jk}}$ (applied with the qcqs scheme $X_{\lambda_0}$ in the role of the scheme called $Y_{\lambda_0}$ there); by [lemma-nagata-qc-open-descends] it is quasi-compact and its inverse image in $X$ is $W_{jk}^\infty$. Replace it by $W_{jk,\lambda_{jk}}:=\widetilde W_{jk,\lambda_{jk}}\cap (X_{\lambda_{jk}}\times_{S_{\lambda_{jk}}}T_{j,\lambda_{jk}})$, where $T_{j,\lambda_{jk}}$ is the inverse image of $T_j$; this is quasi-compact because $X_{\lambda_{jk}}\to S_{\lambda_{jk}}$ is quasi-compact, and its inverse image in $X$ is still $W_{jk}^\infty$. Choose a finite affine cover $W_{jk,\lambda_{jk}}=\bigcup_lU_{jkl}$, so every $U_{jkl}$ maps into $T_{j,\lambda_{jk}}$. For each $j,k,l$, lift the images in $\Gamma(U_{jkl}^\infty,\mathcal O)$ of the finite set $G_{jk}$ to a later stage using [lemma-nagata-filtered-colimit-finite-data]. Since $B_{jk}$ has finitely many defining relations over $R_j$, use the injectivity clause of [lem-weil-pbc-limit-global-sections-colimit] (equivalently clause (2) of [lem-pc-filtered-colimit-commrings-elementwise]) to choose a later stage where all lifted relations vanish. Because $U_{jkl}$ lies over $T_{j,\lambda}$, the resulting maps $B_{jk}\to\Gamma(U_{jkl,\lambda},\mathcal O)$ are $R_j$-algebra maps and hence define $S_\lambda$-morphisms $U_{jkl,\lambda}\to V_{jk}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S_\lambda$.

Let $F_0$ be the finite set of $\lambda_0$ and all stages just chosen, and put $\lambda'=u(F_0)$ using [def-nagata-directed-finite-upper-bound]; by [lemma-nagata-directed-finite-upper-bound] every element of $F_0$ is $\leq\lambda'$. Rebase the system at $\lambda'$ using [def-nagata-basechanged-system] and transport all the opens and chart maps by its canonical comparison maps. Apply [def-nagata-qc-open-equality-stage] to this rebased system (base stage $\lambda'$; $X_{\lambda'}$ is qcqs, being of finite presentation over the qcqs $S_{\lambda'}$, which is affine over $S_{\lambda_0}$) with $W_1=\bigcup_{j,k}W_{jk,\lambda'}$ and $W_2=X_{\lambda'}$, quasi-compact opens whose inverse images in $X$ are both $X=\bigcup_{j,k}W_{jk}^\infty$; call the resulting stage $\lambda_{\cup}$. For each overlap $O_{jkl,j'k'l'}:=U_{jkl,\lambda'}\cap U_{j'k'l',\lambda'}$ (quasi-compact, as $X_{\lambda'}$ is quasi-separated), the two induced maps from the quasi-compact open $O_{jkl,j'k'l'}$ to $Y_{\lambda'}$ have equal base changes to $S$; apply [def-nagata-morphism-equality-stage] to the rebased system (the source open is quasi-compact and of finite presentation over $S_{\lambda'}$) and call the resulting stage $\lambda_{jkl,j'k'l'}$. Let $F=F_0\cup\{\lambda',\lambda_\cup\}\cup\{\lambda_{jkl,j'k'l'}\}$, define $\lambda_\varphi=u(F)$ using [def-nagata-directed-finite-upper-bound] (so every element of $F$ is $\leq\lambda_\varphi$ by [lemma-nagata-directed-finite-upper-bound]), and transport the charts and maps to $\lambda_\varphi$. By [lemma-nagata-qc-open-eq-eventually] the transported $U_{jkl,\lambda_\varphi}$ cover $X_{\lambda_\varphi}$, and by [lemma-nagata-morphism-eq-eventually] the transported chart maps agree on every overlap $U_{jkl,\lambda_\varphi}\cap U_{j'k'l',\lambda_\varphi}$, so they glue to a morphism $\varphi_{\lambda_\varphi}:X_{\lambda_\varphi}\to Y_{\lambda_\varphi}$ whose base change to $S$ is identified with $\varphi$. The construction and selected stage depend on the displayed covers, generators, lifts, relations, and equality-stage witnesses.

blueprint_notes.text:
**Status.** Bypassed by the formalized route: the finite-presentation and
Noetherian descent is done in one step by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.exists_isPullback_of_finitePresentation_of_isSeparated`
and `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.nonempty_noetherianApproximation`, so
this stage-by-stage bookkeeping is never carried out.

split_report.summary: Repaired the definition after the E/C4 return by making every finite choice explicit: a finite affine target cover and generators, descended quasi-compact inverse-image opens and affine refinements, generator lifts and relation-vanishing stages, the finite union-cover equality stage, and all finite overlap-agreement stages. The common stage is the selected upper bound u(F), and the base-changed-system node supplies the descended schemes and comparison isomorphisms. The construction is explicitly choice-dependent; no auxiliary nodes were needed.

Consistent with merged qc-open-descent, qc-open-equality-stage (two opens), morphism-equality-stage, basechanged-system, filtered-colimit-finite-data, upper bound; M1 lemma-nagata-morphism-descends provable (charts base-change to phi|U^inf, U^inf cover X).
